text:
The harbour bridge reopened to traffic on Monday after eight months of repairs to its deck and cables.

The council's engineer said: "The cables were replaced one at a time so that the bridge never had to close to pedestrians." The work finished two weeks early.

Repairs cost 4.2 million pounds, of which the regional transport fund paid half.
